# Mosmos

> 결정은 내가, 맡길 일은 Mos가. 내 AI 매니저 Mos가 애매한 것만 먼저 묻고, 이번 일에 맞는
> AI 작업자들로 작업팀을 꾸려요.
> You keep the decisions; Mos, your AI manager, asks only what's unclear, then puts together
> a team of AI workers that fits the job. This site is
> the prelaunch waitlist (waitlist.mosmos.world).

## Key terms

- Mos (AI 매니저, AI manager) — asks you only what you need to decide, puts together a team
  of AI workers for each job, and collects the results.
- 작업자 (AI worker) — an AI that goes deep on one kind of work, such as writing, design or
  research. Mos calls in the workers a job needs as a 작업팀 (that job's team); when needed,
  workers ask each other and hand work over. The next job gets its own team.

## Pages

- [Waitlist (KO)](https://waitlist.mosmos.world/): join; we roll out gradually and let people
  know by email.
- [Waitlist (EN)](https://waitlist.mosmos.world/en): English version.
- [Waitlist (JA)](https://waitlist.mosmos.world/ja): Japanese version.
- [Privacy policy](https://waitlist.mosmos.world/privacy): what we collect and why.

## Notes

- Prelaunch: no launch date, order, terms or pricing is set yet, and joining the waitlist
  doesn't guarantee access.
- The app is being prepared in Korean, English and Japanese.
- llms.txt is an optional, non-standard hint; crawling permission is governed by robots.txt.
